title: Forward block restriction in symmetric active slices
statement: Use symmetric operadic families and active and inert edges of [def-coef-symmetric-operadic-family], join slices of [lem-coef-infinity-slice-right-fibration], and the cocartesian mapping-space criterion of [lem-coef-infinity-cocartesian-mapping-criterion]. Let $n\geq1$ and let $M^\otimes\to N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)\times\Delta^n$ be a small symmetric operadic family. Write $M_0^\otimes$ for its parameter-zero fiber and define its active incoming slices $J_b=M_0^\otimes\times_{M^\otimes}(M^\otimes_{\mathrm{act}})_{/b}$. Let $b$ have positive coordinate and lie over $\langle s\rangle$, let $a:x\to b$ with $x\in M_0^\otimes$ be active with pointed map $\alpha:\langle k\rangle\to\langle s\rangle$, and choose inert projections $b\to b_j$. Put $D_j=\alpha^{-1}(j)$, and lift the inert maps $\langle k\rangle\to(D_j)_+$ at $x$ to $p_j:x\to x_j$ in $M_0^\otimes$. Then composition with $b\to b_j$ and inert-active factorization gives active arrows $a_j:x_j\to b_j$ and, on coherent triangles and all higher simplices, a natural functor $P:J_b\to\prod_{j=1}^sJ_{b_j}$ sending $(a,h)$ to $(a_j,h_j)$, where the induced block triangles $h_j$, together with their comparison homotopies, are determined up to a contractible space of coherent choices. This includes empty input blocks and $s=0$.

source.place: Proof of Theorem 3.1.2.3, step (1), printed pp.336-337; relative cocartesian factorization and blockwise Segal comparison.
